maddeler.e:
ننطلب (form VII)
# نَنْطَلِبُ (nanṭalibu) /nan.tˤa.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# نَنْطَلِبَ (nanṭaliba) /nan.tˤa.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# نَنْطَلِبْ (nanṭalib) /nan.tˤa.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
